notes: Left pole (vulnerable) relates to care foundation — vulnerability invites protection and nurturance.
Left pole (warm) relates to care — kindness and nurturance.
Right pole (slothful) relates to purity — sloth as a failure of self-discipline and self-improvement.
Left pole (obedient) maps to authority virtue; right pole (rebellious) maps to authority vice / liberty.
Right pole (bourgeoisie) is in MFT dictionary under authority virtue (class hierarchy); the differential also evokes fairness and liberty concerns around class inequality and domination.
Alpha/beta framing relates to dominance hierarchy (authority) and dominance/oppression (liberty).
Right pole (sensitive) relates to care — empathy and sensitivity to others' pain.
Left pole (charismatic) relates to authority — leadership and prestige.
Left pole (insider) is in MFT dictionary under loyalty virtue; right pole (outsider) relates to exclusion (fairness vice).
Left pole (sheeple) implies blind deference to authority; right pole (conspiracist) implies resistance to perceived oppressive authority, relating to liberty.
Left pole (neat) relates to purity — cleanliness and order as purity virtue; right pole (messy) relates to purity vice.
